verdict.rationale: A sandbox or test environment is a fair question for an observability SaaS platform like Datadog, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack never documents a sandbox org, test environment, or any other isolation from production data. The LLM Experiments feature (versioned datasets, comparing results) is about evaluating prompt and model changes, not an isolated sandbox environment, so it is only adjacent and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
